    SELECT TOP(1) [i].[Id], [i].[ContractId], [i].[CreatedAt], [i].[DueDate], [i].[ElectricNewReading], [i].[ElectricOldReading], [i].[ElectricUnitPrice], [i].[ElectricUsage], [i].[Month], [i].[Status], [i].[TotalAmount], [i].[Type], [i].[WaterNewReading], [i].[WaterOldReading], [i].[WaterUnitPrice], [i].[WaterUsage], [i].[Year], [c].[Id] AS [Id0], [c].[CreatedAt] AS [CreatedAt0], [c].[Deposit], [c].[ElectricUnitPrice] AS [ElectricUnitPrice0], [c].[EndDate], [c].[MonthlyRent], [c].[NumberOfOccupants], [c].[RoomId], [c].[StartDate], [c].[Status] AS [Status0], [c].[TenantId], [c].[WaterUnitPrice] AS [WaterUnitPrice0], [r].[Id] AS [Id1], [r].[Area], [r].[BuildingId], [r].[CreatedAt] AS [CreatedAt1], [r].[Description], [r].[ImageUrl], [r].[Price], [r].[RoomNumber], [r].[ServiceFee], [r].[Status] AS [Status1], [t].[Id] AS [Id2], [t].[CreatedAt] AS [CreatedAt2], [t].[Email], [t].[EmergencyContact], [t].[FullName], [t].[IdCardNumber], [t].[Phone], [t].[UserId]
    FROM [Invoices] AS [i]
    INNER JOIN [Contracts] AS [c] ON [i].[ContractId] = [c].[Id]
    INNER JOIN [Rooms] AS [r] ON [c].[RoomId] = [r].[Id]
    INNER JOIN [Tenants] AS [t] ON [c].[TenantId] = [t].[Id]
    WHERE [i].[Id] = @id
) AS [s]

    SELECT TOP(1) [c].[Id], [c].[CreatedAt], [c].[Deposit], [c].[ElectricUnitPrice], [c].[EndDate], [c].[MonthlyRent], [c].[NumberOfOccupants], [c].[RoomId], [c].[StartDate], [c].[Status], [c].[TenantId], [c].[WaterUnitPrice], [r].[Id] AS [Id0], [r].[Area], [r].[BuildingId], [r].[CreatedAt] AS [CreatedAt0], [r].[Description], [r].[ImageUrl], [r].[Price], [r].[RoomNumber], [r].[ServiceFee], [r].[Status] AS [Status0], [t].[Id] AS [Id1], [t].[CreatedAt] AS [CreatedAt1], [t].[Email], [t].[EmergencyContact], [t].[FullName], [t].[IdCardNumber], [t].[Phone], [t].[UserId]
    FROM [Contracts] AS [c]
    INNER JOIN [Rooms] AS [r] ON [c].[RoomId] = [r].[Id]
    INNER JOIN [Tenants] AS [t] ON [c].[TenantId] = [t].[Id]
    WHERE [c].[Id] = @id
) AS [s]
LEFT JOIN [Occupants] AS [o] ON [s].[Id] = [o].[ContractId]
ORDER BY [s].[Id], [s].[Id0], [s].[Id1]
